chapters.title: Introduction to the custom in Shulchan Aruch

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the custom of covering or removing knives from the table during Birkat Hamazon. He reviews the sources for this practice, including the Rokeach, Shiboleh HaLeket, and Abudraham, and notes how the custom was not practiced in Halab.
questions: Why do some people cover knives during Birkat Hamazon?
What are the sources for the custom of covering knives during Birkat Hamazon?
Did the community of Halab cover or remove knives during Birkat Hamazon?
How does the table relate to the altar of the Bet HaMikdash?
